With sum |a_j|²=1, strict pairwise smoothing has derivative dPhi/d(xy)=144-76A-192u+60u²+16xy >=12 using A<= (1-u)². Therefore all moduli equal. Independently enumerated all 4^n group points for n=2,3,4 with nontrivial complex coefficients and matched expansion numerically to rounding; symbolic differentiation reproduced the smoothing derivative. Universal n follows from algebra, not enumeration.
